description: This file contains action creators and utility functions for managing emojis in the Mattermost web application, including loading, updating recent emojis, custom emojis, and user skin tones.

methods.name: loadRecentlyUsedCustomEmojis
methods.description: Loads recently used custom emojis if custom emojis are enabled.

methods.name: incrementEmojiPickerPage
methods.description: Increments the emoji picker page count.

methods.name: setUserSkinTone
methods.description: Sets the user's skin tone preference for emojis.

methods.name: addRecentEmoji
methods.description: Adds a single emoji alias to the recent emojis list.

methods.name: addRecentEmojis
methods.description: Adds multiple emoji aliases to the recent emojis list, updating usage counts and sorting.

methods.name: loadCustomEmojisForCustomStatusesByUserIds
methods.description: Loads custom emojis associated with user custom statuses.

methods.name: loadCustomEmojisForRecentCustomStatuses
methods.description: Loads custom emojis for recent custom statuses.

methods.name: loadCustomEmojisIfNeeded
methods.description: Fetches custom emojis by name if they are not already loaded or known to be non-existent.

methods.name: loadCustomStatusEmojisForPostList
methods.description: Loads custom status emojis for posts in a list.

methods.name: migrateRecentEmojis
methods.description: Migrates recent emojis data from local storage to preferences if needed.
